/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request
url='https://api.genome.ucsc.edu/getData/sequence?genome=hg38;chrom=chr1;start=999999;end=1000100'
print(url)
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=30) as r:
        data=r.read().decode()
    print(data[:1000])
except Exception as e:
    print('ERR',e)
PY"

/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request,json,hashlib
url='https://api.genome.ucsc.edu/getData/sequence?genome=hg38;chrom=chr1;start=999999;end=1000100'
data=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(url))
seq=data['dna']
print(len(seq))
print(seq)
up=seq.upper()
print('up len',len(up))
print(up)
gc=100*(up.count('G')+up.count('C'))/len(up)
n=up.count('N')
print(round(gc,2),len(up),n,hashlib.md5(up.encode()).hexdigest())
PY"

/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request
urls=[
'https://rest.ensembl.org/sequence/region/human/1:1000000..1000100:1?content-type=text/x-fasta',
'https://rest.ensembl.org/sequence/region/human/1:1000000..1000100?content-type=application/json',
]
for url in urls:
    print('URL',url)
    try:
        req=urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'Accept':'application/json'})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30) as r:
            data=r.read().decode()
        print(data[:1000])
    except Exception as e:
        print('ERR',repr(e))
PY"
